package handlers

import "testing"

// scenario for migration_tests_live_under_handler_packages: Migration-specific tests located in transport packages.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func TestMigrationUp(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := "postgres://test:test@localhost:5432/testdb"
	if err := runSchemaMigration(dsn); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("migration up failed: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMigrationDown(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := "postgres://test:test@localhost:5432/testdb"
	if err := rollbackSchemaMigration(dsn); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("migration down failed: %v", err)
	}
}

func runSchemaMigration(dsn string) error {
	return nil
}

func rollbackSchemaMigration(dsn string) error {
	return nil
}
